title: Tomb of Thutmose II announced over a year after discovery

tellings.quote: When I was there in October, I heard about that tomb uh having been discovered earlier in 2024.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns told podcast host Jesse Michels that when he was in Egypt in October 2024, he heard about the tomb of Thutmose II, an ancient Egyptian king, having already been found earlier that year. His point is that the find was only announced to the public more than a year after it was made, which, if true, would mean big discoveries in Egypt can sit quietly for a long time before anyone is told.
